ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, A, M, C, N, B are on the same line segment, and the arrangement order is A, M, C, N, B. Point C is located on line segment AB, M is located on AC, and N is located on CB. Reasoning: Because M is the midpoint of AC, MC = AC/2. Because N is the midpoint of BC, CN = BC/2. From the order in the figure, it can be known that MN is composed of the adjacent MC and CN, therefore MN = MC + CN = AC/2 + BC/2 = (AC + BC)/2. Also because C is on line segment AB, AC + BC = AB = 10 cm. Therefore MN = 10/2 = 5 cm.

method.method_draft: Use segment addition with the two midpoint definitions. From the diagram, note that the points lie on one straight segment in the order A, M, C, N, B, so MN is made of the adjacent pieces MC and CN. From the text, use that M is the midpoint of AC and N is the midpoint of BC, so MC = AC/2 and CN = BC/2. Then MN = MC + CN = AC/2 + BC/2 = (AC + BC)/2. Since C lies on AB, AC + BC = AB = 10 cm, so MN = 5 cm.
